title: Great Zimbabwe
summary: Ancestors of the Shona people built a stone city, settled from about 1000 CE, which became capital of the Kingdom of Great Zimbabwe in the 13th century.
why: The largest stone structure in precolonial Southern Africa.

unsung.contribution: African builders raised the stone city of Great Zimbabwe from the 11th century.
unsung.recognition: Colonial writers credited Phoenicians or Arabs; Rhodesia's government censored archaeologists who said Africans built it.
